errors.text_span: Im Jahr 2023 liegt dieser Wert bei ungefähr 1,7 % des BIP.
errors.evidence: The description gives 1.7% for 2023, but the black total line at 2023 is around 2.8% of GDP in the left panel.

errors.text_span: Im Jahr 1993 stellen die gesamten öffentlichen Anlageninvestitionen einen Wert von knapp 3,2 % des BIP dar.
errors.evidence: The black total line around 1993 is closer to about 3.1% of GDP, so 3.2% is a slight overstatement.
The description does not mention the dashed vertical reference line around year 2000 or the annotation 'Bahnreform²' present in both panels.
The description omits the x-axis tick labels/ordering (1991, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2023) and does not describe the regular tick interval on the y-axis (0.5 increments).
